# Resource (forgejo_team_membership)

Forgejo team membership resource. Manages membership of users in teams.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the team.
- `username` (String) Username of the user to add to the team.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Team membership can be imported using the format: team_id:username
terraform import forgejo_team_membership.example 42:john
```
